title: 第7章 龙娘第8章 元素精灵龙
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
“算了，随你吧”
狄曼列头疼的挥了挥手：“自己去牢房，原来那一间”
听到这话，魅魔的眼睛中又是冒出了爱心：“是特意为我留的吗？一定是的对吧”
“不是”
狄曼列无情的拖着菲莉来到了她的专属牢房前，而后将她扔了进去
锁上牢房门，狄曼列拍了拍手上的灰：“是因为没有犯人愿意住魅魔住的房间”
“明明监狱不止我一个魅魔！！！”
菲莉抓着栏杆不服气的叫着：“你是不是在外面有别的女人了？！”
“逻辑在哪里？”
“因为你不肯和我回家”，菲莉伸手穿过栏杆：“为什么要待在这个破地方嘛？明明审判局都把你踢走了，你都已经不是异端审判官了，干什么还要听他们的指派当这个典狱长呀？”
狄曼列毫不犹豫的用手杖顶部将菲莉给推了回去：
“首先，我不是被审判局驱逐到这里来的，其次我.......”
然而没等狄曼列把话说完，监狱里却是突然响起了金属与水晶碰撞发出的警报声
狄曼列缓缓转头，看向了不远处有些骚乱的广场区
“有人劫狱么？”
随着喃喃自语响起，狄曼列将菲莉的牢房门锁好，随后就转身离去：“乖乖待着，菲莉”
“好哒，狄曼列大人～”
魅魔菲莉像是被击中了心一样尖叫了一声，而后倒在了牢房的床上
狄曼列没有继续理她，而是快步的跑向了监狱大门
他能感受到有两个陌生的生命在监狱大门处，从魔力流动来看应该是人类，尽管这两个人并没有任何敌意和威胁性，但其中一个的气息已经非常微弱

这么想着，狄曼列拨动了一下自己右手的手链，给狱医露诺发去了信号
仅仅片刻，狄曼列已经落在了监狱门口，印入眼帘的是两名女性，从样貌上看应该是母女
而此刻，疑似是女孩母亲的少妇，她此刻正被几名狱警围着，腹部似乎是被什么利器割开，内脏都流出了一些
少女在一旁焦急的哭泣，具有急救技术的狱警正在全力施以急救，但这么重的伤，并不能起到太大作用
眼见狄曼列突然出现，一名狱警快速上前：“啊，狄曼列典狱长，我们刚刚让人去找你了，她们两个突然出现.......”
“汇报等会儿再说”
狄曼列抬手打断了她的话，来到重伤的少妇面前，缓缓蹲下身：“别反抗，痛也尽量忍着”
说完，狄曼列将手指按在了伤口处，丝丝缕缕的魔力渗出，不讲道理的接管了血液中的魔力
“嘶——————”
少妇忍不住呼出了声，但还是咬牙坚持着
狄曼列面色沉静的控制着血液中的魔力，让他们流向了该去的地方，顺便让一部分血肉组织强行融合在了一起
没过多久，狄曼列便收回魔力，起身拿过狱警递来的毛巾擦了擦手：“好了，命保住了，然后.......”
没等少女表达感谢，也没等狄曼列说完，有些无奈的声音已经响起：“剩下的就交给我吧”
狄曼列回头看去，正好看见穿着一件白色外套的精灵露诺走过来
露诺瞪了狄曼列一眼，接着放下了医疗箱：“我到家才两分钟，就又被你叫出来了，饭都还没吃”
“咳，晚上请你吃饭”
content_en:
"Forget it, it's up to you."
Diamanlie waved his hand with a headache: "Go to the cell yourself, the original one."
Hearing this, love appeared in the succubus's eyes again: "Did you leave it specially for me? It must be, right?"
"No"
Dimanlie ruthlessly dragged Feili to her exclusive cell, and then threw her in.
Locking the cell door, Diamanlie patted the dust on his hands: "It's because no prisoner wants to live in the room where the succubus lives."
"Obviously I'm not the only succubus in the prison!!!"
Feili grabbed the railing and shouted unconvinced: "Are you seeing another woman outside?!"
"Where's the logic?"
"Because you refuse to go home with me," Feili stretched out her hand through the railing: "Why do you want to stay in this miserable place? The Inquisition Bureau has obviously kicked you away, and you are no longer an Inquisitor. Why do you still want to obey their orders and be the warden?"
Diamanlie used the top of his cane to push Feili back without hesitation:
"First of all, I was not expelled here by the Tribunal. Secondly, I..."
However, before Diamanlie could finish his words, an alarm sound suddenly sounded in the prison, which was caused by the collision of metal and crystal.
Diamanlie slowly turned his head and looked at the commotion-filled square area not far away.
"Is anyone robbing the prison?"
As he murmured to himself, Dimanlie locked the door of Feili's cell, then turned and left: "Stay good, Feli."
"Okay, Lord Diamanlie~"
The succubus Fili screamed as if she was hit in the heart, and then fell onto the bed in the cell.
Diamanlie did not continue to pay attention to her, but quickly ran towards the prison door.
He could feel two strange beings at the prison gate. Judging from the flow of magic power, they should be human beings. Although these two people were not hostile or threatening in any way, the aura of one of them was already very weak.
With this in mind, Diamanlie flicked the bracelet on his right hand and sent a signal to the prison doctor Luno.
In just a moment, Diamanlie had already landed at the prison door. What caught his eye were two women. Judging from their appearance, they should be mother and daughter.
At this moment, the young woman who is suspected to be the girl's mother is surrounded by several prison guards. Her abdomen seems to have been cut open with some sharp weapon, and some of her internal organs are leaking out.
The girl was crying anxiously on the side, and the prison guards with first aid skills were trying their best to give first aid, but for such a serious injury, it couldn't do much.
Seeing Diamanlie's sudden appearance, a prison guard quickly stepped forward: "Ah, Warden Diamanlie, we just sent someone to find you, and the two of them suddenly appeared..."
"The report will be given later."
Dimanlie raised his hand to interrupt her words, came to the seriously injured young woman, and slowly squatted down: "Don't resist, try your best to endure the pain."
After saying that, Diamanlie pressed his fingers on the wound, and strands of magic seeped out, unreasonably taking over the magic in the blood.
"Hiss——"
The young woman couldn't help but exhale, but she gritted her teeth and persisted.
With a calm expression, Diamanlie controlled the magic power in the blood, letting them flow to where they should go, and at the same time, some flesh and blood tissues were forcibly fused together.
Not long after, Diamanlie withdrew his magic power, stood up and took the towel handed by the prison guard and wiped his hands: "Okay, my life is saved, and then..."
Before the girl could express her gratitude, and before Dimanlie finished speaking, a helpless voice sounded: "Leave the rest to me."
Diamanlie looked back and saw the elf Luna wearing a white coat walking over.
Lunuo glared at Dimanlie, then put down the medical kit: "It's only been two minutes since I got home, and you called me out again. I haven't even eaten yet."
"Ahem, I'll treat you to dinner tonight."
